newsitem.title: USA: Doubletree buys Red Lion Hotels.
newsitem.headline: Doubletree buys Red Lion Hotels.

text.p: Doubletree Corp said on Friday that it has completed its previously announced acquisition of Red Lion Hotels Inc for about $1.2 billion.
Red Lion shareholders would receive $21.30 in cash and 0.2314 shares of Doubletree common stock for each share of Red Lion, Doubletree said.
Red Lion's shareholders approved the deal at a meeting earlier today.
The combined hotel company had 1995 proforma revenues of $600 million and revenues under management of $1.4 billion, Doubletree said.
The combined operation as of September 30, 1996 had a portfolio of 236 properties either owned, under lease, management contract or franchise agreement, Doubletree said.
